faqs.a:
The tastings permit shall be valid for a period of one year, and shall run and expire
               concurrently with the license of the retail liquor store, fermented malt beverage
               and wine retailer, or liquor-licensed drugstore; except, that the first tastings permit
               issued to a retail liquor store, fermented malt beverage and wine retailer, or liquor-licensed
               drugstore licensee shall be valid only until the expiration of the current license.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018; Ord. No.
4839
, § 1, 3-20-2023)
